question: How can the same reality appear both uncovered and covered?
premises: It also shines as if its own nature were covered.
It appears in many ways through association with difference.
inference: The same reality can appear as uncovered, covered, or both, because multiplicity arises through its association with difference.
plain_english: It shines without covering, it shines as if its own nature were covered, and it shines as both covered and uncovered in many ways through its connection with difference.
